outcome: range of motion (ROM) in elevation of the right upper limb
cohort: Five children affected by type C esophageal atresia (EA) who had undergone surgical treatment were included.
finding: Osteopathic manipulative treatment (OMT) was associated with an average increase of 2.3 cm in height and an 8-degree increase in the range of motion of the right upper limb in children surgically treated for esophageal atresia.
